goal: Complete the remaining foundation: 1) real HITL pause every N cycles with readable summary, 2) proper lessons lifecycle (observation/candidate/promoted folders) integrated with Reviewer, 3) minimal git/phone control via status + commands folders, 4) short smoke verification that the full pipeline works together.

what_already_exists: Project structure scanner with fingerprint (PROJECT_STRUCTURE.md + structure_meta.json)
CLI commands: run, pause, stop, status, log, help, history, rollback, exit
Basic lessons_learned.json still present as legacy store
context.why_this_task: Structure, security and reasoning logs are in place. Before real RimWorld work, the system still needs forced human checkpoints, a clean lesson lifecycle, and remote-friendly status/commands so runs are controllable and experience is captured properly.

details: Add config value HITL_EVERY_N_CYCLES (default 3)
After every N completed research-edit-review iterations, pause the cycle
Write a short human-readable summary to console and status/last_summary.md
Summary must include: goal, current_step, iteration_count, last compiler/security result, key agent reasoning, new/updated lessons if any
Accept simple operator replies: continue | stop | note:<text>
If note is given, append it into state.warnings or state.operator_notes and into status/last_summary.md

2_lessons_lifecycle.description: Replace flat-only lessons usage with folder lifecycle
details: Ensure folders exist: lessons/observations/, lessons/candidates/, lessons/promoted/, lessons/deprecated/
Each lesson is a separate JSON file
Minimal schema fields: id, status, rule, why, tags, created_at, source, related_files (optional), priority (optional)
Helpers: create_observation(...), move_to_candidate(id), move_to_promoted(id), move_to_deprecated(id), list_lessons(status=None)
Reviewer path: when should_create_observation is true OR when build/test fails with a clear root cause, create an observation JSON
Optional bridge: keep reading legacy lessons_learned.json if present, but new lessons must go into folder structure
Inject only promoted (and optionally high-priority candidates) into Researcher context

3_phone_git_control.description: Minimal remote control via git-friendly files
details: Maintain status/current.md during runs (live status: step, iteration, last error, need_human)
Maintain status/last_summary.md after HITL pauses
Create commands/ folder watched by orchestrator
Supported command files: pause, continue, stop, note (file body = note text)
After processing, move command file into commands/done/ with timestamped name
Do not build network services; file-based control only

4_orchestrator_integration.description: Wire the above into main.py cleanly
details: On run start: refresh project structure, load promoted lessons into context
Each iteration: update status/current.md
After Editor: security filter -> write/test -> Reviewer
After Reviewer failure with clear cause: create observation lesson
Every N iterations: HITL pause + summary
Periodically check commands/ for remote commands
Keep existing CLI commands working
Run 1-2 short synthetic tasks inside the f(x) working copy
Confirm structure file exists/updates
Confirm security filter still blocks dangerous code
Confirm reasoning logs still write
Confirm lesson observation can be created and listed
Confirm HITL pause happens and writes last_summary.md
Confirm a command file in commands/ is detected and moved to done/

plan.title: Lessons folder lifecycle + helpers
details: Create/confirm lessons/observations|candidates|promoted|deprecated
Implement or extend tools/lesson_manager.py for JSON-per-lesson lifecycle
Add create/move/list helpers with stable unique ids

plan.title: HITL every N cycles
details: Add HITL_EVERY_N_CYCLES to config.py
Implement pause + summary writer
Support continue/stop/note responses

plan.title: Status + commands phone/git control
details: Write/update status/current.md and status/last_summary.md
Implement commands/ watcher and commands/done/ archival

plan.title: Integrate Reviewer -> observation lessons
details: On failed review with root_cause, create observation
Pass promoted lessons into Researcher context

plan.title: Smoke integration check
details: Run short end-to-end verification of all foundation pieces
Fix only critical blockers

constraints: Do not implement Activation Score, sleep, Manager, or semantic search
Do not start RimWorld feature development in this task
Do not rewrite the whole orchestrator from scratch
Keep changes minimal, explicit, and readable
No destructive file operations in tooling
Self-hosted only; no new cloud services
notes_for_agents: Researcher: produce a short technical plan with exact files to create/modify. Prefer extending existing tools (lesson_manager, main.py, config.py) over new frameworks.
Editor: implement one vertical slice at a time. After each write, rely on real runner/security logs. Use relative paths from project root.
Reviewer: approve only with supporting logs. If HITL/lessons/commands integration is incomplete, return concrete fix_instruction. Create observations for real recurring failure patterns.
definition_of_done: lessons/observations, candidates, promoted, deprecated exist and store one JSON lesson per file
Failed reviews can create observation lessons
Promoted lessons are injected into Researcher context
HITL pause triggers every N cycles and writes status/last_summary.md
Operator can continue/stop/note after HITL pause
commands/ files are processed and moved to commands/done/
A short smoke run proves structure + security + reasoning + lessons + HITL + commands work together
No crash on common empty/invalid agent outputs
